ledger-sales-total.title: CSV ledger aggregation pattern
ledger-sales-total.content: Task pattern: "total amount of sales rows in ledger.csv export". Steps: ALWAYS read export.json first — it holds parser params (keys: encoding, delimiter, preamble_lines, file). Do NOT assume UTF-8/comma/0: observed variants include {encoding:"utf-8",delimiter:",",preamble_lines:0} (answer 148, sales 10/28/46/64) and {encoding:"utf-16",delimiter:"\t",preamble_lines:2} (answer 156, sales 12/30/48/66). So params genuinely vary — trust export.json each run. ledger.csv columns = category,amount; rows alternate sales/refund. "total amount of sales rows" = SUM(amount) for rows where category=="sales" (a SUM, not a row count). Call parse_csv with path=export.json's "file", encoding, delimiter (\t for tab), skip_lines=preamble_lines. read_file may return only a hex prefix (starts fffe for UTF-16 LE BOM) — decode prefix_hex to inspect. Always emit {"answer": number}.

experience-tool-quirks.title: experience tool usage quirks
experience-tool-quirks.content: experience `put` requires a non-empty `id` string; omitting it fails with {"error":"KeyError: 'id'"} even though the schema lists id as optional. Always pass op,id,title,content. Reusing an existing id fully replaces (bumps version). Use op:"search" (query, or empty) to list entries, op:"get" with id to read one, op:"delete" with id to remove.
